Pre_Conditions: 1. Write 0x00100000 to set io_ctrl=1 (input mode); 2. Apply known signal to GPIO_8 pin; 3. Read register at 0x00; 4. Check data_in (bit 0) reflects external pin state
Test_Steps: data_in field reflects the actual GPIO pin level in input mode
Status: Functional test: io_ctrl=1 sets input mode; data_in reads pin level

Test_Description: Configure GPIO_8 for positive edge interrupt and verify interrupt triggers
Expected_Result: GPIO_8 in input mode; no pending interrupts
Pre_Conditions: 1. Set io_ctrl=1 (input mode); 2. Set pedge_intr_en=1 (bit 17); 3. Apply rising edge on GPIO_8 pin; 4. Read intr_raw_sts (bit 1); 5. Verify interrupt raw status is set
Test_Steps: intr_raw_sts (bit 1) reads 1 after positive edge detected on GPIO_8

Test_Description: Configure GPIO_8 for negative edge interrupt and verify interrupt triggers
Expected_Result: GPIO_8 in input mode; no pending interrupts
Pre_Conditions: 1. Set io_ctrl=1 (input mode); 2. Set nedge_intr_en=1 (bit 18); 3. Apply falling edge on GPIO_8 pin; 4. Read intr_raw_sts (bit 1); 5. Verify interrupt raw status is set
Test_Steps: intr_raw_sts (bit 1) reads 1 after negative edge detected on GPIO_8

Test_Description: Write 1 to intr_clr to clear GPIO_8 interrupt and verify status clears
Expected_Result: Interrupt raw status is set for GPIO_8
Pre_Conditions: 1. Verify intr_raw_sts=1; 2. Write 1 to intr_clr (bit 16); 3. Read intr_raw_sts (bit 1); 4. Verify interrupt status is cleared
Test_Steps: intr_raw_sts reads 0 after writing 1 to intr_clr

Test_Description: Enable GPIO_8 interrupt via intr_en1 and verify masked status
Expected_Result: Interrupt raw status set for GPIO_8
Pre_Conditions: 1. Write 0x00000001 to intr_en1 (enable GPIO_8 interrupt); 2. Trigger interrupt on GPIO_8; 3. Read intr_sts1 at 0x88; 4. Verify G8_intr_sts (bit 0) = 1
Test_Steps: Masked interrupt status reflects enabled interrupt
Status: Interrupt enable and masked status verification

Test_Description: Use gpio_io_ctrl_group1 to set multiple GPIO pins to output mode simultaneously
Expected_Result: All GPIOs in default input mode
Pre_Conditions: 1. Write 0x000000FF to set G8-G15 io_ctrl=1 with wr_mask=0; 2. Read back individual gpio registers to verify io_ctrl changed; 3. Write 0x00FF0000 (wr_mask=1) to mask writes; 4. Write new io_ctrl values; 5. Verify masked pins unchanged
Test_Steps: Group io_ctrl register correctly controls multiple GPIO pins; write mask prevents unintended changes
Status: Group register functional test for simultaneous GPIO control

Test_Description: Use gpio_dout_group1 to set output data for multiple GPIO pins simultaneously
Expected_Result: GPIO_8 to GPIO_15 set to output mode
Pre_Conditions: 1. Set GPIO_8-15 to output mode via io_ctrl; 2. Write 0x000000FF to dout_group1; 3. Read back individual gpio registers to verify dout changed; 4. Verify GPIO pins reflect output values
Test_Steps: Group dout register correctly drives output data to multiple GPIO pins
Status: Group register functional test for simultaneous dout control

Test_Description: Read gpio_din_group1 to verify input data from multiple GPIO pins
Pre_Conditions: GPIO_8 to GPIO_15 set to input mode with known external signals
Test_Steps: 1. Set GPIO_8-15 to input mode; 2. Apply known signals to GPIO_8-15 pins; 3. Read gpio_din_group1 at 0xB4; 4. Verify G8-G15_din bits match applied signals
Pass_Criteria: Group din register correctly reflects input pin states for GPIO_8-15

Test_Description: Verify both intr1 and intr2 can independently enable/mask GPIO_8 interrupt
Expected_Result: Interrupt raw status set for GPIO_8
Pre_Conditions: 1. Enable GPIO_8 in intr1_en (bit 0=1) and disable in intr2_en (bit 0=0); 2. Verify intr1_sts shows interrupt and intr2_sts does not; 3. Reverse: disable intr1 and enable intr2; 4. Verify intr2_sts shows interrupt and intr1_sts does not
Test_Steps: Both interrupt controllers independently mask/unmask GPIO_8 interrupt

Test_Description: Configure GPIO_8 for level-based interrupt using level_sel field
Pre_Conditions: 1. Set level_sel=0 (interrupt on level 0); 2. Apply level 0 to GPIO_8; 3. Verify interrupt triggers; 4. Set level_sel=1 (interrupt on level 1); 5. Apply level 1 to GPIO_8; 6. Verify interrupt triggers
Test_Steps: Interrupt generated based on level_sel configuration
